crossRefs.note: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever…
“I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…
Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who…
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

translations.web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
translations.bsb: And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
